units: Ages in Myr, converted from the published Gyr (Casagrande, Luck) or kept as published Myr (David).
identity: Hipparcos numbers as published by each catalogue; no positional or name matching.

casagrande2011.catalog: Casagrande et al. 2011, A&A 530, A138: Geneva-Copenhagen survey re-analysis
casagrande2011.method: Bayesian isochrone ages from Hipparcos parallaxes, IRFM temperatures and photometric metallicities; BASTI and Padova isochrones.
casagrande2011.statistics: Expectation, 16%, median and 84% of the age probability distribution for BASTI (EB, 16B, MB, 84B) and expectation, 16%, 84% for Padova (EP, 16P, 84P).

david2015.catalog: David & Hillenbrand 2015, ApJ 804, 146, table 5: nearby B-F field stars
david2015.method: Bayesian isochrone ages from uvby-beta effective temperature and surface gravity; solar composition assumed.
david2015.statistics: Median and 68% interval of the 1D posterior; Age68t is the true probability contained in that interval, percent.

luck2015.catalog: Luck 2015, AJ 150, 88, tables 1-2: G and K giants of the local region
luck2015.method: Isochrone ages from temperature and luminosity with three isochrone sets (Bertelli 1994, Dotter 2008, Demarque 2004); no formal uncertainty is published.
luck2015.statistics: Published mean of the available determinations and the individual Bertelli, Dotter and Demarque ages.
